name: Battle of Hillsbrad
label: Quest
description: Forsaken forces strike Hillsbrad town, aiming to break its human rule. High Executor Darthalia directs the assault from Tarren Mill.

clips.title: The story
paras: Forsaken forces strike Hillsbrad town, aiming to break its human rule. High Executor Darthalia directs the assault from Tarren Mill.

Hillsbrad's human defenders cling to their remaining authority despite heavy losses in the fields and patrols. High Executor Darthalia knows that peasants and militia rally behind the town's leaders. She sends Forsaken operatives into the Town Hall to kill Magistrate Burnside and five councilmen, cutting off the town's command.

Darthalia aims to break Hillsbrad's civic life as well as its leadership. She orders operatives to burn the Hillsbrad Proclamation, a political document tied to the settlement's charter and pride. They also seize the town registry, taking official records and citizen rolls from surviving Alliance loyalists. The registry gives Undercity's intelligence a detailed view of the local people.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The town of Hillsbrad is in disarray and we believe it will soon fall. We must, however, persist in our ruthlessness until the human scum are wiped from the foothills for eternity.

Despite their overwhelming losses, the humans rally around their leadership and keep fighting. We must eliminate their leader, Magistrate Burnside, as well as the town council. Destroy their revered political document as well, the Hillsbrad Proclamation. And while you're at it, steal the town registry.

clips.title: Completion
paras: News of your glories in Hillsbrad traveled fast. You have done well, adventurer.
